targets.name: Carved owl
targets.concealment: Its wooden plumage follows the surrounding carved leaves and vertical bookcase grain.

targets.name: Newel-post hare
targets.concealment: The hare is carved into the same golden-brown stair post and merges with foliage carving.

targets.name: Carved desk mouse
targets.concealment: The mouse shares the grain and warm tone of the desk pedestal between books and turned legs.

targets.name: Running fox relief
targets.concealment: The animal is a low-contrast relief within a continuous frieze of carved leaves, with its tail following their curves.

targets.name: Carved frieze bird
targets.concealment: It blends into the repeating gold foliage at the far right of the balcony apron.

targets.name: Round magnifying glass
targets.concealment: The thin brass handle runs alongside the book spines and its transparent lens repeats their colors.

targets.name: Tied feather bundle
targets.concealment: The pale tied quills follow book spines beside the stair and are partly tucked behind the upper shelf.

targets.name: Shelf hourglass
targets.concealment: Amber glass and the slim wooden frame match the narrow books and vertical shelf supports.

targets.name: Brass balance scales
targets.concealment: Its fine gold lines are embedded among window mullions, hanging herbs, glass bottles and railing details.

targets.name: Brass mortar and pestle
targets.concealment: The small brass mortar and diagonal pestle blend into railings, warm timber and other thin metal fittings.

targets.name: Tied paper bundle
targets.concealment: The paper-wrapped bundle matches the pale edges of adjoining books and its knot blends with dried stems.

targets.name: Sleeping cat
targets.concealment: The curled cat has a complete outline on the stair tread.

targets.name: Large floor lantern
targets.concealment: The lit foreground lantern is large and immediately recognizable.

targets.name: Basket of apples
targets.concealment: A broad wicker basket and red apples stand apart from the stone floor.

targets.name: Golden watering can
targets.concealment: The polished can is clearly displayed on the right-hand shelf.
